channel.title: Cork Safety Alerts - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Cork Safety Alerts (corksafetyalerts.com)

item.title: RSA Launches "Crash Hour" Campaign Targeting Ireland's Deadliest Time on Roads
item.description: RSA launches Crash Hour campaign: 27% of road fatalities happen between 4pm-8pm. Slow down, stay alert, save lives during evening commute.

item.title: Design Team Appointed for N25 Midleton-Youghal Bypass Project
item.description: Design team appointed for N25 Midleton-Youghal bypass project. Public consultation expected to begin during two-year Options Selection phase.

item.title: EU Unveils Major Action Plan to Counter Drone Security Threats
item.description: EU launches major Action Plan to counter drone security threats with €250m border surveillance initiative and new detection systems.

item.title: HSE Expands Free Mental Health Support for Young People Across Ireland
item.description: HSE launches free mental health support for 16-30 year olds across Ireland through partnership with Togetherall. Anonymous, 24/7 online community.

item.title: Jack Lynch Tunnel Overnight Closure 23:00 - 01:00
item.description: The Jack Lynch Tunnel will close overnight tonight, from 23:00 to 01:00. South Bore Closure. Adjust your commute, and plan alternative routes accordingly.

item.title: Emergency Departments Across Cork Face Extremely High Activity Levels
item.description: If your condition is not urgent, consider your pharmacy, GP, SouthDoc or Injury Units.

item.title: 147 Cost Rental and Social Apartments Approved for Cork City Centre
item.description: 147 new cost rental and social apartments approved for Cork city centre at Anglesea Terrace, with construction to begin in 2027.

item.title: Coast Guard Exercise Underway Along Fountainstown to Myrtleville Coastline This Evening
item.description: Increased Coast Guard presence between Fountainstown and Myrtleville this evening is a routine training exercise. No cause for alarm.​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​

item.title: Collision on N25 Eastbound
item.description: Reports of a collision, eastbound, on the N25 between Little Island and Carrigtwohill. Emergency services are en route. Take care on approach.

item.title: Jack Lynch Tunnel Closure Now Active
item.description: The Jack Lynch Tunnel South Bore Closure is now closed. The tunnel will reopen at 01:00. Adjust your commute, and plan alternative routes accordingly.
